data.name: SagaCraft
data.detailed_description:
SagaCraft is an action-RPG set in the fantasy world of Slavic mythology, where the story adapts to you. A mysterious evel is consuming the ancient land, and how you fight it is entirely up to you. Become a legendary hero, defeat villains, and protect the your people. Explore fairnative lands, collect enchanted weapons, interact with living characters, and write your own story!

Powered by cutting-edge artifical intelligence, our game allows you to talk live to any character, forging a completely unique fairy tale with every playthrough.

WORD IS YOUR GREATEST WEAPON

Forget boring, pre-scripted dialogue trees. In SagaCraft, you interact with villagers, forest spirits, and ancient deities organically – using your microphone or typing on your keyboard. Threaten, negotiate, uncover secrets, or just crack a joke. Smart NPCs will react to your exact words, and the virtual storyteller will steer the plot into uncharted territory.

Bribe a water demon, interrogate a treacherous peasant, or try to outsmart the immortal Koschei. The choice is truly yours, and the world will remember it.

SHATTER THE MYTHS

Words can only get you so far. When negotiations fail, unleash a fluid, high-octane combat system blending visceral melee, evasive maneuvers, and devastating spellcasting. Cleave through swarms of restless undead, outmaneuver vicious Kikimoras, and memorize attack patterns to survive boss fights against legends like Baba Yaga and Nightingale the Robber.

HUNT FOR FABLED RELICS

The ancient weapons awaits those who deserve it. Scavenge corrupted lands for rare crafting materials and long-lost relics. Trade with wandering merchants, forge powerful weapon upgrades, and tailor your build through expansive skill trees. Track down fabled artifacts like the Seven-League Boots or the legendary magic Sword Kladenets to tip the scales in your favor.

FORGE YOUR LEGEND

Step into the shoes of archetypal Slavic heroes, each boasting a wildly different playstyle. Play as the Bogatyr, a hulking brute who turns simple wooden clubs into engines of raw righteousness destruction. Go out to the fight as a nimble Vityaz who attacks the enemy like lightning. Or command the arcane as the Enchantress, a cunning spellcaster capable of reducing horrors to ash or weaving ancient healing magic.

NO TWO RUNS ARE ALIKE

Victory is not the end – it’s just a new draft of the fairy tale. Every playthrough generates a fresh, procedural world and story. Biomes shift, enemy encounters change, and NPC allegiances reset. Even your plot is generated anew. You will never explore the same map, face the same threats, or experience the exact same story twice.

TOTAL:

  • Visceral Action Combat: String together deadly combos and master magic to conquer punishing boss fights.

  • Living Narrative: No pre-written script. The plot bends and breaks based on your conversations and choices.

  • Old Slavic Mythos: Explore an untamed fantasy world inspired by ancient folklore.

  • Infinite Replayability: Procedurally generated maps, shifting loot pools, and randomized encounters keep every run fresh.

  • True Voice-Driven RPG: Speak directly into your mic (or type) to converse with fully adaptive AI characters.

data.short_description: Step into an untamed Slavic fantasy where no two tales are the same. SagaCraft is a dynamic action-RPG where you speak to fully adaptive characters to alter an unscripted storyline. Crush legendary beasts, scavenge for mythical loot, and explore procedural lands in a world that reacts to your words.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3050 (8 Гб)
  • Storage: 80 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 5070 (12 Гб)
  • Storage: 80 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Images of fairytale monsters, like dragons and skeletons. Cartoonish flashy battles WITHOUT BLOOD, appropriate for child under adult supervision.
